payNO, applyId, fundsDate, payType, tableName, tID, moneyAmount, selfAcountsName, selfBankNo, selfBankName, selfBankID, otherAcountsName, otherBankNo, otherBankName, paymentState, companyName, companyId, companyType, comments, addtime, userId, UserName, update_time, delFlag,

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment ( applyId, payNO, fundsDate, payType, tableName, tID, moneyAmount, selfAcountsName, selfBankNo, selfBankName, selfBankID, otherAcountsName, otherBankNo, otherBankName, paymentState, companyName, companyId, companyType, comments, addtime, userId, UserName, update_time, delFlag ) SELECT pa.id AS applyId, UUID() AS payNO, -- 生成唯一的付款编号 pa.fundsDate, pa.payType, pa.tableName, pa.tID, pa.moneyAmount, NULL AS selfAcountsName, -- 根据需要填充 NULL AS selfBankNo, -- 根据需要填充 NULL AS selfBankName, -- 根据需要填充 NULL AS selfBankID, -- 根据需要填充 pa.otherAcountsName, pa.otherBankNo, pa.otherBankName, '申请中' AS paymentState, -- 默认设置为申请中 pa.companyName, pa.companyId, pa.companyType, pa.comments, pa.addtime, pa.userId, pa.UserName, NOW() AS update_time, 0 AS delFlag FROM paymentApply pa WHERE pa.id = #{applyId}
